users.description: Settings related to allowed users with access to the settings and editor.

ids.description: List of user IDs with access to the settings and editor.
ids.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable the editor for specific user IDs.
ids.help: Comma separated list of user IDs. Example: 1,2,3

roles.description: List of user roles with access to the settings and editor.
roles.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable the editor for specific user roles.
roles.help: Comma separated list of user roles. Example: administrator,editor

enqueue.description: Enqueue assets in frontend and editor.
enqueue.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the enqueueing of assets in frontend and editor.

reset.description: Control removal of WordPress core block styles and editor reset parity.

enabled.description: Remove WordPress core block styles on the frontend and in the editor, and restore common utility-class display and position values in the editor canvas.
enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the removal of WordPress core block styles and the editor utility layout reset.

fullWidth.description: Post types where the editor uses full-width layout by removing classic editor constraints.
fullWidth.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to control which post types use full-width editing.

css.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the minification of CSS.

js.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the minification of JS.

scss.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the processing of SCSS in .css files.

scssFiles.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the processing of .scss files to CSS.

cache.description: Settings related to Blockstudio runtime caching.

enabled.description: Enable Blockstudio file-backed runtime, block registration, and editor asset caches.
enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable all Blockstudio file-backed runtime and editor asset caches.

path.description: Cache directory. Relative paths resolve from WP_CONTENT_DIR; absolute paths are used as provided.
path.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to change the Blockstudio file-backed cache directory.

githooks.description: Settings for repository hooks generated and owned by Blockstudio development tooling.

commit.description: Generate an analysis-only pre-commit hook when blockstudio-githooks sync runs.
commit.descriptionFilter: This filter exposes whether the Blockstudio-owned PHPStan commit hook is enabled.

phpstan.description: Settings consumed by the canonical blockstudio-phpstan command and Blockstudio-owned analysis hook.

preset.description: Analysis preset used when the command line does not select one explicitly. The theme and extreme-theme layers are opt-in and must be selected here or on the command line.

configuration.description: Project PHPStan configuration file to include alongside the preset. Relative paths resolve from blockstudio.json. Use it to adopt analysis on an existing project through a baseline.

roots.description: Theme roots analyzed by the canonical command. Relative paths resolve from this configuration file.

excludePaths.description: Additional scanner exclusions relative to each configured root.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files inspected by the theme scanner.

themeDefaults.description: Generic defaults for themes that load Blockstudio.

suppressDirectoryUpdates.description: Remove the active child and parent theme from WordPress.org directory update results.

syncPagesInDevelopment.description: Reconcile file-backed pages when their source signature changes in local or WP_DEBUG environments.

performance.description: Opt-in generic frontend runtime behavior. Compat preserves WordPress defaults; speed and strict enable the documented optimization profile.

profile.description: Base runtime profile. Explicit child values override the selected profile.

headNoise.description: Remove generator, emoji, feed, discovery, and adjacent-post head output.

embeds.description: Remove oEmbed discovery and host scripts.

editor.description: Disable remote patterns, Openverse, application passwords, and the block directory.

frontendAssets.description: Remove generic core frontend styles and scripts when the theme owns its asset output.

media.description: Apply image quality, generated-size, and async decoding defaults.

heartbeat.description: Throttle Heartbeat to at least 60 seconds outside editor screens.

links.description: Prefetch same-origin documents after hover, focus, or touch intent.

media.description: Stable image rendering and lazy-loading behavior.

lazy.description: Use the Blockstudio intersection-observer image loader.

skeleton.description: Show the built-in media skeleton while lazy images load.

metadata.description: Declare that assets/media.json is generated and maintained for stable dimensions.

rootMargin.description: Intersection observer root margin for lazy images.

measurement.description: Opt-in diagnostics for development and measurement environments.

enabled.description: Enable runtime measurement snapshots and hooks.

queryMonitor.description: Include queries taking at least 50ms in snapshots when SAVEQUERIES data is available.

headers.description: Send Blockstudio performance profile and configuration headers.

timings.description: Include elapsed request time in the opt-in response headers.

staticPrerender.description: Configuration reserved for Blockstudio's file-backed prerender runtime.

enabled.description: Enable static prerender generation and serving.

earlyServe.description: Serve eligible prerenders before the full WordPress template lifecycle.

serveLoggedIn.description: Allow logged-in requests to receive prerendered documents.

dynamicPaths.description: Path prefixes that must always remain dynamic.

content.description: Settings for Content Sync, the WP-CLI driven projection of allowlisted WordPress content to portable files.

enabled.description: Enable Content Sync configuration for this theme.
enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable Content Sync.

id.description: Content-set identity stored on synced entities. Prune and ownership checks are scoped to this value.
id.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to set the Content Sync ownership namespace.

path.description: Theme-relative directory where Content Sync reads and writes files.
path.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to set the Content Sync file directory.

includePageSyncManaged.description: Include Page Sync managed posts. Their post_content remains owned by Page Sync.
includePageSyncManaged.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to include or exclude Page Sync managed posts.

authors.description: Author portability mode. Use ignore to omit authors or login to store author logins and resolve existing users on push.
authors.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to configure Content Sync author handling.

postTypes.description: Allowlisted post types to sync. Empty means no post types are synced.
postTypes.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to configure Content Sync post type allowlists.

meta.description: Postmeta allowlist, exclude list, and declared reference rewriting rules.

include.description: Glob patterns for meta keys that may be projected to files.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for meta keys that must never be projected, even if included.

references.description: Declared meta references. Only these keys and paths are rewritten between local IDs and portable UIDs.

path.description: Optional dot path inside structured meta. Use * to map every array item.

taxonomies.description: Allowlisted registered taxonomies whose terms and post relationships are synced. Taxonomy definitions are not captured.
taxonomies.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to configure Content Sync taxonomy allowlists.

media.description: Attachment reference behavior. manifest records referenced attachments and validates them on push; none drops attachment references.
media.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to configure Content Sync media handling.

enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable Tailwind.

config.description: Tailwind CSS configuration using v4 CSS-first syntax.
config.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to add a custom Tailwind CSS configuration.

ui.description: Settings related to bundled UI components.

enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable bundled UI components.

formatOnSave.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the formatting of code upon saving.

assets.description: Additional asset IDs to be enqueued.
assets.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enqueue additional assets in the editor.

markup.description: Additional markup to be added to the end of the editor.
markup.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to add additional markup to the end of the editor.

disableLoading.description: Disable loading of blocks inside the Block Editor.
disableLoading.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to disable the loading of blocks inside the Block Editor.

enhance.description: Enable Blockstudio editor affordances such as cleaner focus styles and hover/selection outlines.
enhance.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable Blockstudio editor affordances such as cleaner focus styles and hover/selection outlines.

cssClasses.description: Stylesheets whose CSS classes should be available for choice in the class field.
cssClasses.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to add stylesheets whose classes should be available for choice in the class field.

cssVariables.description: Stylesheets whose CSS variables should be available for autocompletion in the code field.
cssVariables.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to add stylesheets whose CSS variables should be available for autocompletion in the code field.

blocks.description: Global block editor policies that map to WordPress PHP block editor hooks.

allow.description: Block names that are allowed in the inserter. Supports wildcards such as core/*.
allow.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to control the block names that are allowed in the inserter.

deny.description: Block names that are removed from the inserter. Supports wildcards such as core/embed.
deny.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to remove block names from the inserter.

directory.description: Enable the WordPress block directory assets in the editor.
directory.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable the WordPress block directory assets in the editor.

categories.description: Filter, rename, and order block inserter categories by slug.

allow.description: Block category slugs that should remain available. Empty means all categories are allowed.
allow.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to control which block category slugs remain available.

deny.description: Block category slugs that should be removed from the inserter.
deny.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to remove block category slugs from the inserter.

rename.description: Map block category slugs to replacement labels.
rename.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to rename block category labels by slug.

order.description: Block category slugs that should be moved to the beginning of the inserter in the provided order.
order.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to order block category slugs in the inserter.

deny.description: Map block names to PHP-registered block style names that should be unregistered. Use * as a style name to remove all registered styles for a block.
deny.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to unregister PHP-registered block styles by block name.

legacyWidgets.description: Policies for the legacy widget block.

hide.description: Legacy widget IDs that should be hidden from the legacy widget block.
hide.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to hide additional legacy widgets from the legacy widget block.

patterns.description: Global pattern inserter policies that map to WordPress PHP pattern hooks.

core.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable WordPress core block patterns.

remote.description: Enable remote patterns from the WordPress pattern directory.
remote.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable remote patterns from the WordPress pattern directory.

theme.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable theme-provided block patterns.

blockstudio.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable Blockstudio file-based patterns.

categories.description: Filter, rename, and order block pattern categories by slug.

allow.description: Pattern category slugs that should remain available. Empty means all categories are allowed.
allow.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to control which pattern category slugs remain available.

deny.description: Pattern category slugs that should be removed from the pattern inserter.
deny.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to remove pattern category slugs from the pattern inserter.

rename.description: Map pattern category slugs to replacement labels.
rename.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to rename pattern category labels by slug.

order.description: Pattern category slugs that should be moved to the beginning of the inserter in the provided order.
order.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to order pattern category slugs in the inserter.

media.description: Global media policies for the block editor.

openverse.description: Enable the Openverse media category in the block editor media inserter.
openverse.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable the Openverse media category in the block editor media inserter.

imageSizes.description: Filter image size choices shown in editor media controls.

allow.description: Image size names that should remain available. Empty means all image sizes are allowed.
allow.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to control which image size names remain available in editor media controls.

deny.description: Image size names that should be removed from editor media controls.
deny.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to remove image size names from editor media controls.

ai.description: Settings related to AI-powered context generation.

enableContextGeneration.description: Enables the automatic creation of a comprehensive context file for use with large language model (LLM) tools (e.g., Cursor). This file compiles current installation data: all available block definitions and paths, Blockstudio-specific settings, relevant block schemas, and combined Blockstudio documentation, providing a ready-to-use resource for prompt engineering and AI code development.
enableContextGeneration.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable or disable context file generation for LLM tool integration. When enabled, the context file assembles up-to-date block data, Blockstudio settings of the current install, all relevant schemas, and Blockstudio documentation into a single source for use with AI development tools.

blockTags.description: Settings for bs: tag rendering. Controls page-level replacement of <bs:block-name> tags with rendered block output. Template-level rendering is always active.

enabled.description: Enable page-level bs: tag rendering in post content and widget areas.
enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable page-level block tag rendering.

allow.description: Allowlist of block name patterns. Supports wildcards via fnmatch(). When set, only matching blocks render via tags.

deny.description: Denylist of block name patterns. Supports wildcards via fnmatch(). Matching blocks are excluded from tag rendering. Takes precedence over allow.

prefixes.description: Prefix to namespace shorthands for block tags. Each key is a lowercase prefix without dashes, and each value is a namespace string or ordered namespace array.
prefixes.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to register prefix to namespace shorthands for block tags.

grab.description: Settings related to the element grabber.

enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the element grabber.

perf.description: Enable the performance profiler. Shows Server-Timing headers and a debug panel on every page load.
perf.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the performance profiler.

enabled.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to enable/disable the canvas.

adminBar.description: Show the WordPress admin bar when viewing the canvas.
adminBar.descriptionFilter: This filter allows you to show/hide the WordPress admin bar on the canvas.
